expressions.name: Spark
expressions.expression:
count    = static.sparkCount
button   = buttonVars.sparkON
selfBuzz = buttonVars.selfBuzz
arm      = buttonVars.armIgnition
sparkon  = 0

button   = button or static.ignition

if arm == 1 then
 if selfBuzz == 1 and button == 1 then
    "DO:Spark" = 1
 endif

 if selfBuzz == 0 and button == 1 and arm == 1 then
    sparkon = 1
    if "DO:Spark" == 1 then
       "DO:Spark" = 0
    else
       "DO:Spark" = 1
    endif
 endif
else
 "DO:Spark" = 0
endif

if button == 0 then
   "DO:Spark" = 0
endif    

count = static.sparkCount
spark = "DO:Spark"
"DO:Igniter" = sparkon
sparkon

expressions.name: LOXFuelOutletControl
expressions.expression:
// Controls individually and together the LOX and Fuel outlet valves

runState     = static.testState
LOXOut       = buttonVars.LOXOutEn 
FuelOut      = buttonVars.FuelOutEn
FuelDirect   = buttonVars.FuelDirect
timedFuel    = buttonVars.TimedFuelOut or buttonVars.mixedOut
timedLOX     = buttonVars.TimedLOXOut or buttonVars.mixedOut
LOXbyWeight  = static.LOXOutValve
FuelbyWeight = static.FuelOutValve
FakeFuel     = buttonVars.doFakeFuel
static.prevGoFuel
static.prevGoLOX

goLOX  = 0
goFuel = 0

if ((FuelbyWeight and FakeFuel) or LOXOut or LOXbyWeight) then
    goLOX = 1
    if (static.prevGoLOX != goLOX) then
        print("Turning on LOX output")
        if ( FakeFuel and FuelbyWeight ) then
            print("Turning on Fuel output because FAKEFUEL is ON")
        endif
    endif
endif
if (FuelDirect or FuelbyWeight) then
    goFuel = 1
    if ( static.prevGoFuel != goFuel ) then
        if ( FuelDirect ) then
            print("Turning on Fuel DIRECT")
        endif
        if ( FuelbyWeight ) then
            print("Doing Fuel Fill by Weight")
        endif
    endif
endif
        
static.prevGoFuel = goFuel
static.prevGoLOX  = goLOX

"DO:LOXOUT"  = goLOX
"DO:FuelOUT" = goFuel

expressions.name: Test Sequencer
expressions.expression:
// Test Sequencer
// Uses a state machine to step through 
// shut off mixing, purge, mix on, pause, ignite
// run a set time, mix off, purge - done

static.testState      //idle

static.deltaTime     
static.preStartTime    = 500
static.prePurgeTime    = 1500
static.prePurgeOverlap = 0
static.ignitionTime    = 600
static.postVentTime    = 2000
static.postBleedTime   = 2000
static.postPurgeTime   = 4000
static.abort1PurgeTime = 1000
static.abort2PurgeTime = 4000
static.pressTimeOut    = 2000
static.runTime         = 3000
static.overlapRun

static.ignition      // these output to control expressions that take in buttons or sequence output
static.LOXVent  
static.FuelVent 
static.Purge    
static.LOXOut   
static.FuelOut  

startTest = buttonVars.runTest
abort     = buttonVars.abort or buttonVars.purge
purgeIn   = buttonVars.purge

TankPress = "AI:Ch P"
setP      = static.runTankSetPoint

IDLE           = 0
PRESTART       = 1  // condition on, press off
PREPURGE       = 2  // purge on, wait timed amount
STARTPRESS     = 3  // purge off, press on wait for press >= set point
IGNITION       = 4  // fire 
RUN            = 5  // wait run time, goes to POSTPURGE
POSTPURGE      = 6  // purge, goes through engine
ABORTPOSTVENT  = 7  // vent only, depress tank
ABORTPOSTBLEED = 8  // purge + bleed, clear line
ABORTPOSTPURGE = 9  // purge, goes through engine
ABORT          = 10  // go through the abort post events

state     = static.testState
deltaT    = static.deltaTime

purge   = 0
vent    = 0
bleed   = 0
igniton = 0

if ( (abort or buttonVars.purge) and (state) and (state < ABORT) ) then
    static.deltaTime = 0
    static.overlapRun = 0
    state = ABORT
endif

if ( state == IDLE ) then    // IDLE
    if ( startTest > 0 ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        static.overlapRun = 0
        state=PRESTART
    endif
else if ( state == PRESTART ) then
    mixon = 0
    if ( deltaT > static.preStartTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = PREPURGE
    endif
else if ( state == PREPURGE ) then
    purge = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.prePurgeTime ) then
        state = STARTPRESS
        static.deltaTime = 0
        purge = 0
    endif
else if ( state == STARTPRESS) then
    if ( TankPress >= setP ) then
        state = IGNITION
        static.deltaTime = 0
    endif
    if ( deltaT > static.pressTimeOut ) then
        state = ABORT
        static.deltaTime = 0
    endif
else if ( state == IGNITION ) then
    ignition = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.ignitionTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = RUN
    endif
else if ( state == RUN ) then
    if ( deltaT > static.runTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = POSTPURGE
    endif
else if ( state == POSTPURGE ) then
    vent  = 0
    purge = 1
    bleed = 0
    if ( deltaT > static.postPurgeTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = IDLE
    endif
else if ( state == ABORTPOSTVENT ) then
    vent  = 1
    bleed = 0
    purge = 0
    if ( deltaT > static.postVentTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = ABORTPOSTBLEED
    endif
else if ( state == ABORTPOSTBLEED ) then
    vent  = 0
    purge = 1
    bleed = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.postBleedTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = ABORTPOSTPURGE
    endif
else if ( state == ABORTPOSTPURGE ) then
    vent  = 1
    purge = 1
    bleed = 0
    if ( deltaT > static.postPurgeTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = IDLE
    endif
else if ( state == ABORT ) then
    static.deltaTime = 0
    state = ABORTPOSTVENT
endif

if ( state > 0 ) then
    static.deltaTime = static.deltaTime + 7.215  //Valid for 160Hz update rate
endif

static.ignition    = ignition
static.Purge       = purge
static.RunTankVent = vent
static.doBleed     = bleed

static.testState = state

expressions.name: RunTankPressurization
expressions.expression:
// Run Tank Press Controller
static.runTankSetPoint = 50.0
static.pressRunTank
static.runTankPressLockout

depress      = buttonVars.depressRunTank
autoDepress  = static.RunTankVent
manualVent   = depress
state        = static.testState
TankPress    = "AI:Ch P"
setP         = static.runTankSetPoint
lockOut      = static.runPressTankLockout
RunTankMaxP  = static.RunTankMaxP
ventFromLoad = static.ventFromLoad

if state >= 3 and state < 6 then  // PURGE complete, going to PRESSURIZE
    enable = 1
else
    enable = buttonVars.RunTankPressEn 
endif

if depress or lockOut then
    enable = 0
    lockOut = 1
    static.runPressTankLockout = lockOut
endif

if depress == 0 and buttonVars.RunTankPressEn == 0 then
    lockOut = 0
    static.runPressTankLockout = lockOut
endif

Run_Press_ON = 0
Run_Vent_ON  = 0

if (enable  and (TankPress < setP)) then
    Tank_Press_ON = 1
    Tank_Vent_ON  = 0
    "DO:PURGE"    = Tank_Press_ON
endif

if ( depress ) then
    Tank_Press_ON = 0
    Tank_Vent_ON  = 1
    "DO:PURGE"    = Tank_Press_ON
endif

if (TankPress > RunTankMaxP) then
    Tank_Press_ON    = 0
    Tank_Vent_ON     = 1
    "DO:RunTankVent" = Tank_Vent_ON
endif

static.pressRunTank = Tank_Press_ON

"DO:RunTankVent" = Tank_Vent_ON or autoDepress or ventFromLoad 
if Tank_Press_ON then
    "DO:PURGE"       = Tank_Press_ON
    static.FueldoBleed = 0 //line condition valve OFF
    static.LOXdoBleed  = 0
endif

scaleWeight = "Scale:Scale0"

expressions.name: Fuel-Fill_By_Weight
expressions.expression:
// Fill Fuel by weight.
// Read _weight continuously at first, when _weight rises by nn grams assume fuel is now going in.
// Save the _weight at this point as _static.LOXWeight, calculate needed fuel _weight to reach _static.massRatio.
// Continue to fill until total _weight equals target = LOXWeight * (1+MR)
// Minimum LOX to start is 100g

static.massRatio
static.fuelFillState
static.fuelWeight
static.prevFuelWeight
static.prevLOXWeight

static.LOXLossToLNGinput = 0.6  // grams/gram LOX boiled off for each gram of LNG added ~0.5 to 0.7 g/g

weight = "Scale:Scale0"
button = buttonVars.FillFuelByWeight
reset  = buttonVars.resetFuelFill

targetWeight = static.targetWeight
targetFuel   = static.targetFuel
LOXWeight    = static.LOXWeight
CorrectedLOX = static.CorrectedLOX
fuelWeight   = static.fuelWeight
fullWeight   = static.fullWeight
fuelOut      = static.FuelOutValve
minWeight    = static.minWeight
state        = static.fuelFillState
massRatio    = static.massRatio

L0 = static.L0   // initial LOX
Lf = static.Lf   // calculated final LOX
R  = static.R    // desired fuel to LOX MR
F  = static.F    // LNG mass to add

IDLE             = 0
START            = 1
WAITFORMASSUP    = 2
CALCNEEDEDMASS   = 3
WAITFORFINALMASS = 4
COMPLETE         = 5

if ( reset ) then
    state = IDLE
endif

if ( state == IDLE ) then
    if ( button ) then
        if ( L0 < 100 ) then
            print("Min LOX not reached: %f", L0)
        else
            state = START
        endif
    endif
    fuelOut = 0
else if ( state == START ) then
    minWeight = weight
    state = WAITFORMASSUP
else if ( state == WAITFORMASSUP ) then
    fuelOut = 1
    if ( weight <= minWeight) then
        minWeight = weight
    else if ( weight > minWeight + 1 ) then
        LOXWeight = weight
        state = CALCNEEDEDMASS
    endif
else if ( state == CALCNEEDEDMASS ) then
    L0 = weight                    // initial LOX weight from current scale weight
    R  = massRatio                 // desired Fuel / LOX
    b  = static.LOXLossToLNGinput  // LOX boil off to LNG added g/g
    F  = (R*L0) / (1 + (R*b))      // target LNG load
    Lf = L0 / (1 + (R*b))          // LOX expected final weight
    targetFuel   = F
    targetWeight = Lf + F
    static.L0 = L0
    static.Lf = Lf
    static.F  = F
    static.R  = R
    LOXWeight = L0
    fuelOut   = 0
    state = WAITFORFINALMASS
else if ( state == WAITFORFINALMASS ) then
    fuelWeight = weight - L0
    if ( fuelWeight >= targetFuel ) then
        fuelOut = 0
        state = COMPLETE
    else
        fuelOut = 1
    endif
    static.movingLOXTarget = targetWeight - targetFuel
else if ( state == COMPLETE ) then
    state = IDLE
endif

static.fuelFillState = state
static.FuelOutValve  = fuelOut

fullWeight           = weight
static.minWeight     = minWeight
static.targetFuel    = targetFuel
static.targetWeight  = targetWeight
static.fuelWeight    = fuelWeight
static.LOXWeight     = L0 - (fuelWeight * static.LOXLossToLNGinput)
static.fullWeight    = fullWeight
